description: Said the horn is the old one, and that she boils the new on Monday.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the stopped bells without missing them, and named the Monday ink.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Spoke once of Ghent, and went out by the north door.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat his pew, did not speak, and had no sword-bearer.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Heard Ghent and did not take it up.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Said nothing, and was asked nothing.
name: William Shakespeare
